The manufacturing process of the steel 
 pipes
 The ERW Black Steel Pipes are manufactured by experienced and 
 highly skilled workers. These pipes are developed by the 
 superior quality of raw material which is collected from the 
 reliable market place. All the material collected is tested 
 before use to avoid the poor quality of substances to mix in the 
 manufacturing of the pipes. The manufacturing process is carried 
 out under the strict supervision of the hired expert who has an 
 excellent knowledge about the manufacturing of the pipes.
For their smooth finish and excellent 
 workability, the pipes move through various stages in the 
 production process. These pipes are developed as per the demand 
 of the clients and all the guidelines are followed that are 
 stated by the customers.
Quality assurance and material 
 testing
 The main aim is to provide the superior quality of the pipes 
 that are provided to the well-esteemed clients. Quality of the 
 pipes is checked at every stage of the manufacturing process. 
 During the development of the pipes, all the well stated 
 manufacturing norms are followed. All the national and 
 international set of quality standards are kept in analyzing the 
 quality of the
 Carbon Steel ERW Black Steel 
 Pipes.
The quality checkers conducts different tests to 
 check the quality of the pipes that are manufactured to avoid 
 last stage delays in delivery of the product. Conduction of 
 tests ensures the clients about the safely manufacturing of the 
 product that they are provided with. The various tests that they 
 conduct are hardness test, hydrostatic test, ultrasonic test, 
 intergranular corrosion test, positive material test, and 
 flattening test.
The attribute of pipes 
 Various features that make the pipes appropriate to be used in 
 the industries are-
 • Excellent corrosion resistance
 • Kept in high temp
 • Good tensile strength
 • Good reliability 
Documents
 Many documents are attached to ensure the clientele that no 
 harmful product is used in the manufacturing of the pipes. Some 
 of the documents are fumigation certificate, radiology test 
 report, packaging list, chemical test reports, commercial 
 invoice, and guarantee letter of the company.
Packing of the pipes
 The 
Mild Steel ERW Black Steel Pipes
are packed in the wooden boxes protected with the 
 plastic cover. So, that pipes won’t be destroyed in the 
 transporting from one place to another. All the necessary 
 details are attested with the wooden boxes to clarify the 
 details of the product delivered.
